svg.title: A Sobolev-independent energy with a fixed root gap
svg.desc: Three exact real sections of z0 squared over2 plus z1 squared over2 epsilon squared equals1. Blue and rust points are unit-energy branch eigenvectors. A fixed epsilon gives norm comparison independent of the Sobolev exponent. The ellipses flatten when epsilon tends to zero. The full operator energy also includes an H minus1 term to control its lower-order remainder.
svg.text: The principal energy does not depend on the Sobolev weight
Pε = Dₜ² − ε²Dₓ², ξ > 0: Eε(z) = z₀²/2 + z₁²/(2ε²), Eε = 1
½‖z‖² ≤ Eε(z) ≤ (2ε²)⁻¹‖z‖²: fixed ε gives constants independent of s.
As ε → 0 the roots merge; the comparison constant is not uniform in ε.
Real fibre sections shown. Homogeneous jets are used away from zero frequency.
Exact proof: §3.1 U1–U4 and Exercise 24. Mathematical antecedent: Hörmander III, §23.2.
